propositions: Multiple Jira write dispatch paths (ACLI, REST, SDK) can multiply writes or leave acceptance ambiguous; a single provider-neutral retry budget with bounded invocations and cumulative sleep is required.
Exact summary-only mutations must bypass legacy generic retry and use a dedicated executor-selected route with three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep.

Cloud executor must perform one ACLI process per write with recovery using primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest, not ACLI JQL; DC executor must use jira.JIRA with max_retries=0 and follow GET→PUT→GET without hidden repeats.

Observation of desired summary after timeout indicates recovered success; conclusive old state may replay within remaining budget; ambiguous or failed observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Each terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log with logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and message capped at 512 Unicode code points; total log capped at 1,024 Unicode code points.

Constructor-injected internal route selector must default to legacy, add no config/env key, and preserve existing retry behavior for all non-selected operations; S3 owns cutover and durable deferral consumption.
